Zoe (marketing): Starter Lab launch went out at 07:12 PT. Early numbers look promising. Thinking a light webinar + gated appendix to convert more devs.
Ken (devrel): Nice! Quick metrics?
Zoe (marketing): 18h: 2.9k pageviews, 175 newsletter signups, 8 repo clones, 6 demo requests.
Hana (content): Most signups came from the inline code sample CTA.
lead-router: 2 leads failed routing: missing 'utm_campaign' -> parked in manual-review.
Priya (ops): Can default utm_campaign -> 'organic-starterlab' and tag as 'auto-defaulted' so SDRs can filter. I can patch and reprocess later today.
Miguel (growth): Webinar idea: "Starter Lab: deploy, tune, and measure LLM inference". 40-60 devs, demo + benchmarking + cost tips. Capture repo downloads and demo opt-ins.
Ken (devrel): Important bench note: the post shows ~40ms latency measured at batch=1 on a dedicated small. We should add a clear callout about batching and tokens/sec to avoid confusion.
Hana (content): I'll add a bolded callout: "Latency numbers are single-request (batch=1) on dedicated nodes; batching and different hardware change throughput. Full configs in appendix." Also propose A/B CTAs: Variant A 'Watch the live walkthrough' vs Variant B 'Download code + benchmark appendix'.
Zoe (marketing): Action items:
- Hana: update post copy + add CTA variants (EOD)
- Priya: implement utm default + reprocess 2 leads (today)
- Ken: draft webinar outline + confirm Rafael for runtime section (tomorrow)
- Miguel: build reg page + $600 promo budget (48h)
Priya (ops): Reprocess command I'll run after prod deploy:
```bash
./bin/reroute --filter missing_utm_campaign --assign utm_campaign:organic-starterlab --tag auto-defaulted
```
Ken (devrel): Proposed agenda: 10m intro, 20m hands-on demo, 15m benchmarks & ops tips, 10m live Q&A. Rafael to cover runtime tuning and quantization tradeoffs.
Miguel (growth): Drip cadence: confirm email + 5d reminder, 2d, 1d, 1h. I'll own emails and initial ad buys.
Zoe (marketing): Also let's track CTA A/B: CTR -> reg -> demo funnel. If variant B drives more repo downloads but fewer live regs, we can gate the appendix after the webinar.
Hana (content): Will post the updated paragraph and both CTA buttons in this thread when done.
Priya (ops): Routing change on staging, doing quick smoke now; will push to prod in 15m and reprocess.
Zoe (marketing): Great — tag this thread when tasks complete so SDRs can pick up leads. :rocket:
